hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root=[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path); while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root '.git'))) { $parent=Split-Path -Parent $root; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or $parent -eq $root) { exit 0 }; $root=$parent }; $runner=Join-Path $root '.codex\hooks\run-hook.ps1'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)) { exit 0 }; & $runner -Hook 'check-evolution'; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$roots=@(); if ($env:VIBE_CODING_SKILLS_HOME) { $roots += $env:VIBE_CODING_SKILLS_HOME }; $cursor=[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path); for ($i=0; $i -lt 64; $i++) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $cursor '.codex\hooks\check-routing-session.ps1') -PathType Leaf) { $roots += $cursor; break }; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $cursor; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or $parent -eq $cursor) { break }; $cursor=$parent }; $hook=$roots | ForEach-Object { @((Join-Path $_ 'codex-hooks\check-routing-session.ps1'),(Join-Path $_ '.codex\hooks\check-routing-session.ps1')) } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $hook) { exit 0 }; $utf8=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false); $global:OutputEncoding=$utf8; [Console]::InputEncoding=$utf8; [Console]::OutputEncoding=$utf8; $payload=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); & $hook -HookInput $payload; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
